description: Finds high-voltage substations near a project or location and returns transformer MVA ratings, capacity headroom, estimated upgrade costs, and equipment bills of materials. Pass a substation name, project name, city, or coordinates.

headroom_class.description: Filter substations by available capacity headroom class.

include_bom.description: Include N-1 substation equipment Bill of Materials estimate.

include_upgrade_scope.description: Include parametric substation upgrade cost and lead-time estimate.

limit.description: Maximum number of substations to return (default: 10).

location.description: City, county, or market location (e.g. 'Columbus, OH', 'Ashburn, VA').

min_voltage_kv.description: Minimum substation voltage class in kilovolts (e.g. 138, 230, 345).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Optional project ID to audit nearby or linked substations (e.g. 'P017').

project_name.description: Optional project name to audit substations for (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene').

query.description: Substation name, project name, or location query (e.g. '345 kV substations near Columbus, OH').

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around the target coordinates (default: 25).

requested_load_mw.description: Requested load in megawatts for upgrade scope and equipment BOM sizing (e.g. 200).

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

substation_name.description: Substation name or partial match (e.g. 'Lancium Clean Campus Substation', 'Dulles').

target_expansion_mw.description: Target expansion load in megawatts for upgrade sizing (e.g. 300).

target_mw.description: Alias for requested load in megawatts (e.g. 200).

name: audit_substation_and_upgrades

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.

title: Audit Substation Capacity and Upgrades
